title: Insurance Claim Services Mold Protocol Supplement: Surface Treatment by Growth Location
content:
**Rule.** In the protocol supplement of Insurance Claim Services, the surface treatment is priced as follows: for growth in an attic or crawlspace, soda blasting of the growth area at the tier's soda blasting rate, because media blasting is the method the attic tier allows on framing and sheathing; for growth in the HVAC system, the tier's air handler cleaning fee and coil cleaning fee; for growth in a living area or basement, wire-brush sanding and encapsulation of the growth area at the tier's rates per square foot.

The growth location, growth area and tier are those recorded on the Mold Remediation job awaiting clearance; the rates and fees are that tier's.

| Growth location | Surface treatment priced |
|---|---|
| attic or crawlspace | growth area multiplied by the soda blasting rate |
| HVAC system | air handler cleaning fee plus coil cleaning fee |
| living area or basement | growth area multiplied by the sum of the wire-brush sanding and encapsulation rates |

*Hypothetical:* 220 square feet of attic growth at a soda blasting rate of 2.40: 528.00. HVAC growth on a tier with an air handler cleaning fee of 410.00 and a coil cleaning fee of 245.00: 655.00, whatever the growth area.
